subject.title: Docs landing page: stale brand hero, missing fourth quick-start card, fallback card icons

question: Should maintainers accept the linked docs landing/brand refresh as the canonical fix and coordinate it with the openclaw/docs icon-renderer PR?
rationale: The maintainer label protects this item, and the remaining work is a docs/brand rollout decision across the source docs and the published docs shell rather than an autonomous repair task.

options.title: Review linked PRs together
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102880 and https://github.com/openclaw/docs/pull/96 as the canonical fix path and close this issue only after they land or are rejected.

options.title: Narrow the source PR
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a smaller OpenClaw-only docs source change if the generated hero or palette update needs design revision.

options.title: Reject the refresh direction
options.body: Close the linked PRs and this issue only if maintainers decide the current docs branding and fallback icon behavior should remain unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Review linked PRs together
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102880 and https://github.com/openclaw/docs/pull/96 as the canonical fix path and close this issue only after they land or are rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current proposal and also shows relevant recent docs history for the affected source files.
